def transform(grid):
    # Pack each left-to-right object into a down-right chain, sharing its
    # predecessor's bottom-right cell. Later objects take precedence there.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v})
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        shape = {(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells}
        objects.append((c0, color, r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    r0 = c0 = 0
    for i, (_, color, oh, ow, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        if i:
            pr, pc = previous_bottom_right
            r0, c0 = pr, pc
        for dr, dc in shape:
            r, c = r0+dr, c0+dc
            if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                out[r][c] = color
        previous_bottom_right = (r0+oh-1, c0+ow-1)
    return out
